name: Sangam Finserv Limited
about: Sangam Finserv Limited, a non-banking finance company, engages in lending and investment activities in India. It offers secured business and corporate loan; and invests in shares, securities, and other financial instruments. The company was formerly known as Suchitra Finance & Trading Company Limited and changed its name to Sangam Finserv Limited in June 2023. Sangam Finserv Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mumbai, India. Sangam Finserv Limited operates as a subsidiary of Marigold Investrade Private Limited.
